statements.text: Right now, China is getting access to the specialized equipment used to make advanced computer chips. This bill stops that by tightening the rules and making sure everyone plays by the same rules, so American workers aren’t getting screwed.
statements.venue: Press release backing the MATCH Act

statements.text: Upstate New Yorkers are already paying through the nose for electricity, and we shouldn’t have to pay a penny more so Big Tech can rake in record profits. If out-of-state tech companies want to build data centers here, they can pay their own way – not stick Upstate families with the bill.
statements.venue: Press release introducing the FAIR Data Act

statements.text: At the heart of that debate is a simple question: Who pays for it?

statements.text: We need to listen to our neighbors, and what our neighbors are telling us very loudly and very clearly is that we cannot have these data centers coming in, steamrolling us, and then sticking us with the bill for all of it.
